subject: Post-contract playbook: staged cutover, canary & evaluation cadence (AuroraSync)
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Post-contract playbook: staged cutover, canary & evaluation cadence (AuroraSync)

Hi Samir / Aurora team,

Thanks again for signing — excited to get moving. Attached is an initial mutual action playbook that embeds the post-signature implementation plan we discussed: staged rollout, canary window, migration cutover steps, and the evaluation cadence for the first 30 days. High-level asks: 

- Please confirm the two-week canary window (we've proposed 10/12 - 10/26) and the pilot customer list (2–3 accounts).
- Confirm training attendee lists for the two hands-on sessions (eng + ops).
- Share your preferred maintenance blackout windows for migration (we recommended weekend hours).

Attachments: AuroraSync_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP with action owners), Canary-Checklist.xlsx, Training-Schedule-week1.pdf

A few notable decisions baked into the MAP:
- Canary will run on a single shard with KV cache warmed using replayed test traffic; rollback plan includes instant traffic reroute to blue pool + automated cache flush.
- Evaluation plan: daily token-level latency and cost reports + weekly quality check against the seeded eval set. Any regression >5% will trigger a freeze and escalation.
- Training: two sessions (week 0 admin orientation, week 1 hands-on integration) with recorded artifacts and a short quiz to validate readiness.

Can we lock the canary start by EOD Friday? I'll schedule a short kickoff (30m) after you confirm.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Subject: Re: Post-contract playbook: staged cutover, canary & evaluation cadence (AuroraSync)

Samir — 11am PT on 10/07 works for orientation. A few clarifications from the enablement side: 

- Suggested canary ramp: Day 1 = 5% for 6 hours, Day 2 = 15% for 12 hours, Day 3 = 35% steady, Day 4+ = 60–75% before full cutover on a pre-agreed low-traffic window. We'll include gating checks in the Canary-Checklist.xlsx.
- Network fallback: blue-pool fallback uses your existing public endpoints; we only ask for ephemeral access to your staging subnets for pre-cutover validation (read-only). We will not perform writes without an approved change window.
- Training plan: Week 0 admin orientation (60m live) + Week 1 two 90m hands-on sessions (dev integration and ops runbook). We'll record and post to the Drive link.

I'm attaching the quick-run script and an annotated ops checklist for the pilot.

Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v1.2 submitted — updated timelines + action owners

Samir / team,

Thanks for the quick replies. I've updated the MAP (AuroraSync_MAP_v1.2.pdf) to reflect the agreed ramp and added explicit acceptance gates. Notes below: 

- Canary window: 2026-10-12 09:00 PT -> 2026-10-26 23:59 PT. Ramp schedule is as Laura outlined; detailed percentage steps in the Canary-Checklist.xlsx (attached).
- Pilot accounts: please confirm three accounts listed on page 3 of the MAP by 2026-10-05 so we can pre-warm caches and run smoke tests.
- Roles: Implementation owner = Samir (AuroraSync), Redwood on-call = Ben Carter (primary) / Marissa Cole (backup).
- Evaluation: Daily automated report (latency, token cost, error rate) will land in the shared Drive and we will hold a 30m sync every Tue/Wed during canary week to review.
- Decision criteria for go/no-go are listed under section 4: performance SLOs, no more than 2 production incidents of severity >=2 during ramp, and successful verification on the seeded eval prompts.

Next steps:
1) Samir — confirm pilot accounts and blackout windows by 10/05.
2) Aurora SRE — grant read-only staging subnet access for pre-cutover validation (ephemeral keys) by 10/08.
3) Redwood — schedule the two training sessions (10/07 orientation + 10/13 hands-on) and share invites.

I moved the HubSpot deal HS-45822 to "Implementation: In progress" and attached the DocuSign exec summary link in the MAP.

If that all looks good, I'll book the kickoff for Monday 10/05 09:30 PT.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
